about.title: About the LaoChristian.org apps
about.intro: We create applications that help Lao people learn about Jesus Christ and the Bible.
about.mission: LaoChristian.org supports Lao Christians worldwide with accessible, high-quality digital tools for spiritual growth and worship. Built on faith, simplicity, and modern technology, the platform brings together resources used by Seventh-day Adventists and other Christians who cherish God's Word and worship in Lao.
about.generation: These apps continue the Lao Books series, originally developed from resources provided by LaoBible.net and the Lao Seventh-day Adventist Church. Reimagined as fast, minimal Progressive Web Apps, they work online and offline and are designed for accessibility, low-bandwidth use, and simple navigation.
about.script: Modern Lao script support lets these digital Christian apps avoid outdated typographical tricks such as invisible spaces, providing cleaner and more reliable text across devices.
about.bible: The Lao Bible app provides a faithful, easy-to-read digital edition.
about.songs: The Lao Songs app is a curated collection of worship and spiritual songs sung in Lao churches around the world. It supports worship in homes, small groups, and congregations.
about.songbook: It is a growing digital songbook that preserves the heart of Lao worship across generations and places.
about.commitment: All resources on LaoChristian.org are provided freely in the spirit of Christian service and global mission. Our aim is to help Lao believers engage with Scripture and sacred music wherever they are.
about.improve: We continue to expand and improve the platform with new resources and tools.
about.quote: If you lose Heaven, you lose everything; if you gain Heaven, you gain everything.
about.tagline: Rooted in faith. Built for the journey.
